content.short: Dfns is a Wallets-as-a-Service (WaaS) platform offering secure wallet APIs for digital asset management.
content.description: Dfns provides Wallets-as-a-Service (WaaS) designed for fintechs, financial institutions, and enterprises worldwide to simplify digital asset management and securely onboard users into crypto. Its secure wallet APIs offer Wallet Entitlement Management (WAM) for governing wallet workflows and a Key Deployment Service (KDS) that centralizes management of multiple keys from a single platform. Together, these tools help organizations enforce strong security, meet compliance requirements, and uphold regulatory standards across multi-chain deployments.
content.meta: Dfns provides wallet infrastructure for digital assets. Discover Dfns and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Introducing Transaction Screening
resources.tldr: The first check shipped is lookalike detection for address poisoning, an attack that beats careful people because it exploits how humans compare long strings.

resources.title: Introducing Vaults
resources.tldr: A managed multichain account with composite balances, quarantine by default and a ledger behind it. Good on why custody needs its own data model rather than a list of keys.

resources.title: AWS CloudHSM Support
resources.tldr: Hardware-grade key custody inside your own AWS account rather than a vendor's. Worth reading for the trust boundary it moves and the operational burden it hands back to you.
